translation: In injuries from falls and blows, although one regulates and treats with the manual techniques, one fears that they may not fully obtain what is appropriate, so that there is the suffering of treating as if not treating. Then one cannot yet speak of the thoroughness of medical principle. Therefore, according to the image of the body's upper and lower, front and side, one makes instruments to correct it, using them to supplement what the manual techniques cannot reach, hoping that the separated are rejoined, the leaning are made upright, the high are brought to level, and the sunken are raised to their position. Then critical conditions can be turned to safety, and severe injuries can be brought to lightness. Then, applying the merit of medicines and food, and further showing the goodness of regulation and nourishment, the way of bone-setting is complete.
